mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.content, p.images, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.create_time, p.user_id, u.nickname, u.avatar, CASE WHEN pl.id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS liked FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN post_like pl ON p.id = pl.post_id AND pl.user_id = #{userId} WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT p.id, p.content, p.images, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.create_time, p.user_id, u.nickname, u.avatar, CASE WHEN pl.id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS liked FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN post_like pl ON p.id = pl.post_id AND pl.user_id = #{userId} WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.deleted = 0
